title: The Future Of Health
text:
Verily has an ambitious strategy to become a key player in the health industry, and has reliable partners that will help to make this real. It is a significant bet of Google ( GOOG ) (NASDAQ: GOOGL ) that could start generating serious earnings in the mid-future and disrupt the health industry. Source: Author’s Compilation Verily has 16 projects divided into four categories, sensors, interventions, Health platforms population health and precision medicine. These projects at a glance seem unrelated, but a closer look proves that they are closely intertwined. Verily will also help Google’s hardware business and leverage other assets Google has invested on. General Health Google’s plan for general Health starts with a Watch. The Study watch Project developed a Watch with multiple sensors that monitor user’s activity by analyzing physiological and environmental data. It is the key for Google to have information to use, which is what Google does best. Source: Verily If Verily decides to make the Study Watch available for sale or launch a commercial version, it could be the nail that seals the coffin for Fitbit ( FIT ). It has impressive capabilities, and Verily has a much stronger health platform than Fitbit, even with Fitbit’s acquisition of Twine health, Verily could outrun them. The watch capabilities could also be incorporated into a Google Watch or Android Wearable to give an edge vs. Apple ( AAPL ) wearables. It will be interesting to see if Project Jacquard will be integrated to provide more comprehensive data gathering. More on Project Jacquard on this video. The watch is currently being used in Project Baseline , which aims to map the health conditions of individuals to understand the transition from health to disease better. Project Baseline is providing a Study Watch to each of the 10 thousand people in the study. All the information will be analyzed to develop a baseline map of healthiness, which then will be used by Project Healthcare Performance Measurement (PHPM) to transform the Project Baseline data to a technology platform toolset. The platform would is a partnership between 3M ( MMM ) and Verily and would provide a platform for hospitals, healthcare providers, payers and strategic partners can find areas of opportunity and improve costs. As Google and Verily Partner with hospitals, the new Cybersecurity business ( Chronicle ) of Google could be rolled out. Tackling a niche market that thus far only CynergisTek ( CTEK ) is going after. Diabetes Diabetes is one of the most common and threatening health risks right now, the best way to understand how Verily will approach diabetes care is to know how Project Onduo will work. Source: Onduo Onduo is an app that monitors diet and behaviors of diabetes patients and uses Google magic and professional coaches to help patients monitor and improve their behaviors. Right now Onduo gets the information from either a continuous glucose monitor or an external glucose monitor via Bluetooth or manual input. For the app to work, it needs information, which right now is limited. Here enter the two other sensor projects of Verily. The Miniaturized Continuous Glucose Monitor (CGM) Project is being done in collaboration with Dexcom ( DXCM ) arguably the leader in continuous glucose monitoring. Source: Dexcom Investor Relations On the last DEXCOM earnings call, it was stated that the sensor should end development phase in the first half of 2019. Hopefully, sales will start by 2020; it was emphasized the aggressive cost reduction thoroughly. Smart lens Program aims to develop smart ocular devices, including a glucose-sensing lens for continuous monitoring of glucose levels and an accommodating contact lens for people with presbyopia (age-related farsightedness). The Smart lens program is being worked with Alcon (NYSE: ALC ), and it works well with the Retinal imaging Project, which Verily is working together with Nikon ( OTCPK:NINOF ) that is developing technology for early detection of Diabetic retinopathy (DR) and diabetic macular edema (DME) by using machine learning. Interestingly enough, Verily just publish “ Eyes: a window into heart health ” that uses machine learning to identify cardiovascular risk factors and measure blood pressure. Source: Verily Proving that these projects could have a much more significant scope that they were initially designed for. Parkinson The Personalized Parkinson project aims to use ParkinsonNet to identify patterns that influence the progression of Parkinson. The study will use molecular analysis, advanced brain images and sensors to monitor the behaviors and progression of each patient. This information could be crucial to developing patient-specific treatments. The sensor could be the Study watch or other developed by Verily for the MS Observational Study project . Verily also has Liftware , a small company it acquired that produces utensils that can be used with better ease by people with tremors by applying a technology similar to the one of steady Cams. More on Liftware on this video Another significant advancement that could improve the life of Parkinson Patients is between Galvani bioelectronics and Verb Surgical, where Verily is partnering with GlaxoSmithKline ( GSK ) and Johnson Johnson ( JNJ ) respectively. Galvani aims to research, develop and commercialize bioelectronic medicines, and Verb Surgical is developing a surgery platform integrated with robotics to take surgery technology to the next level. These projects could increase the effectiveness and precision of Deep Brain stimulation operations. Their plans go hand in hand. How about profit Google often plans for long-term monetization. However, there are clear points where Verily will bring cash directly or indirectly. As for Google’s partner’s monetization will be slow but confident, it is good news but not a game changer because of the size of the companies with one exception: Dexcom. For Dexcom, the Miniaturized CGM is not a side project, it is THE project that may change the company. The cost reduction for the continuous glucose monitor could break a significant barrier for diabetes patients and become an option for non-insulin intensive patients. The Deal with Verily states that if the annual sales of the project are below $750 thousand, Verily will not be paid Royalties. So Google is counting that the product will bring much more than that in revenue, Dexcom had less than $600 Thousand in revenue last year, if successful the Miniaturized CGM would change Dexcom Valuation drastically. In Conclusion The capabilities developed for the Study Watch and the platform would strengthen Android’s Value and Google’s Hardware business. Each one of the projects would be a drop in the bucket for Google, but 16 drops could form a nice little stream. Dexcom Play is exciting but keeps in mind the timing, it is at least two years away from coming true, and even then disposable glucose monitors is such a disruptive concept that it will take some time to explode. Verily is not only an exciting play for Google, but a responsible one and the progress it generates fighting these devastating diseases is admirable. Verily projects will take some time, but they are worth the wait. Disclosure: I am/we are long GOOG, CTEK. I wrote this article myself, and it expresses my own opinions.
